The visit date is in dispute: the system holds 30/08/2025 10:00 (event 017, today), while the tenant says she arranged 8 September 2025 (event 021). Neither date is confirmed by the provider. Tell the tenant the visit date is not final: the record shows 30/08 10:00, she says 8 September, and we are checking with the provider. We will write once confirmed. Target is within 14 days (routine).
Record the name, provider and phone-number conflicts on the job.
Hold the job for the provider's reply, review 2025-09-01.

Confirm the visit date with the provider and update the tenant. Owner: agency.

Resolve the tenant name conflict (Ruben Oakley / Clara / Grace Mercer) and the provider name conflict (Keystone Compliance / Riverside Works / Keystone Utilities / Lantern Utilities SMS). Owner: agency, before the visit.
Examine the oven and issue a quote if needed; the visit result is not yet known.

answers.answer: The job is at visit stage with Keystone Compliance assigned and landlord approval given for a visit. The visit date is unresolved: the system holds 30/08/2025 10:00 (today), and the tenant says she arranged 8 September. The provider has not confirmed either date. Outstanding: the provider's reply on attendance and date, the visit itself, the diagnosis and any quote.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Email Keystone Compliance (existing thread, event 014) to confirm whether they attended on 30/08 and the correct date agreed with the tenant. Email the tenant (existing thread, event 015) to say the date is not final and the agency is checking. Review the hold on 2025-09-01.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: No escalation now. The date conflict is routine and the provider can settle it. A human is needed only if the provider cannot confirm or the repair later needs spend above what the landlord has approved.

tickets.description:
Hi there,

Hope you are well.

Apologies for bringing something to attention not long after moving in. Apart from this one small issue, everything else seems fine, and we are really enjoying the comforts of the property! :)

I am not sure if I am missing something on the fan oven. We finally managed to get around to using the oven on Tuesday evening,
(It's been a long and stressful move-in from the old place to here, so apologies for not checking this sooner).
The oven doesn't seem to heat up using the main oven section. I can confirm that the grill heating element works, as I used this last night to cook with, but the main oven heating element doesn't seem to work. On Tuesday evening, we had the oven running for at least an hour to try and get it up to 200 degrees, but it was not heating up at all.

I looked through the instruction booklet I found and am certain I am not missing anything in relation to how the oven operates.

Is this something that could be looked at, please?

Kind regards
Clara
